scoring.player_zh: 卡里姆·阿卜杜尔-贾巴尔（大学时名卢·阿尔辛多）
scoring.evidence: Points 1. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, 1966-67 870 (cross-confirmed by UCLA official records PDF: 'Most Points: 870 by Lew Alcindor, 1967' and 'POINTS SCORED: 1. Lew Alcindor 1967 870 29.0')

assists.evidence: Assists 1. Lonzo Ball, 2016-17 274 (Note: older UCLA media guides listed Pooh Richardson 236 as record, but Lonzo Ball's 274 in 2016-17 surpassed it; Donovan Dent 265 in 2025-26 is second, Larry Drew 256 in 2012-13 third)

scoring.evidence: Robinson's 1,030 points during the 1993-94 season are a school record. He is the only player in Big Ten history to eclipse the 1,000-point plateau in a season.

assists.evidence: He finished the season with 345 assists, leading the country and ranking fifth all-time on the NCAA single-season assists list (Braden Smith's prior marks: 292 in 2023-24 was a Purdue and Big Ten record at the time; 313 in 2024-25; 345 in 2025-26 is the school record)

scoring.evidence: Rice remains at the top of Wolverine history with career points (2,442), single-season points (949, 1988-89) and single-season three-point field goal percentage (51.6 percent, 1988-89)

assists.evidence: Burke also earned the GARY GRANT AWARD FOR MOST ASSISTS, as he closed the season setting the U-M single-season and sophomore class record with 260 total assists.

scoring.evidence: From Calbert Cheaney career stats table on IUHoosiers.com: 92-93 season row: G=35, GS=35, FGM=303, FGA=552, FTM=132, FTA=166, Pts=785, Avg=22.4 (cross-confirmed by sports-reference.com: 'Points 1. Calbert Cheaney, 1992-93 785')

assists.evidence: Additionally, his 195 assists this season are the second-most in a single season in IU history, trailing Isiah Thomas' 197 set during the 1980-81 season. (cross-confirmed by sports-reference.com: 'Assists 1. Isiah Thomas, 1980-81 197')
